notes.title: Major Reworks in Progress
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. So sorry for the hiatus. I've been hard at work on the game, smoothing out the rough edges on both design and aesthetics. A few months ago, I decided to reboot development in order to make improvements to the project. While I haven't yet reached back to the developmental stage the game was in prior, I've been making good pace, and a new build should be available in the near future. In this post is what the game looks like currently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731137/8cd8a06075c9893f6efcae7e4c1f1ae455160890.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731137/dfe662330ee95f083ef7e690c74321472f8331f6.png[/img]

More work still needs to be done, but I ask that you please stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Developer Direct Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! I've been working away at the game for a bit now, and I want to share some of the new changes coming to the game in the next build. Some of these changes and additions I talked about in a Developer Direct release in July. You can watch that here:
[previewyoutube=keDrhPhOGIw;full][/previewyoutube]
